ex.en: The school is five kilometers from my home.
ex.zh: 學校離我家五公里。

ex.en: It is three kilometers from here to the bank.
ex.zh: 從這裡到銀行有三公里。

ex.en: This car can go thirteen kilometers for every liter of gasoline.
ex.zh: 這輛車每公升汽油可以跑十三公里。

ex.en: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶急救箱。

ex.en: I keep a tool kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我在車上放了一套工具組。

ex.en: The welcome kit includes a map and a badge.
ex.zh: 迎賓包裡有一張地圖和一個名牌。

ex.en: I have gained two kilograms this summer.
ex.zh: 這個夏天我胖了兩公斤。

ex.en: How many kilograms did you lose last month?
ex.zh: 你上個月瘦了幾公斤？

ex.en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
ex.zh: 米是按公斤賣的。

ex.en: That child may have been kidnapped on his way home.
ex.zh: 那個孩子可能在回家路上被綁架了。

ex.en: He is accused of kidnapping.
ex.zh: 他被控綁架。

killer.zh: 殺手；致命的東西（疾病等）

ex.en: Heart disease is the number one killer in many countries.
ex.zh: 在許多國家，心臟病是頭號殺手。

ex.en: Stress can be a silent killer.
ex.zh: 壓力可能是隱形殺手。

ex.en: The camera is the killer feature of this phone.
ex.zh: 相機是這支手機的殺手級功能。

ex.en: That was a killer presentation!
ex.zh: 那場簡報太精彩了！

ex.en: How many kinds of birds are in your backyard?
ex.zh: 你家後院有幾種鳥？

ex.en: I don't want to buy this kind of sofa.
ex.zh: 我不想買這種沙發。

ex.en: There are all kinds of people in the world.
ex.zh: 世界上什麼樣的人都有。

ex.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.
ex.zh: 他很好心，借了我一些錢。

ex.en: Tom is one of the kindest people I know.
ex.zh: 湯姆是我認識最善良的人之一。

ex.en: I'm kind of tired today.
ex.zh: 我今天有點累。

ex.en: The movie was kind of boring.
ex.zh: 那部電影有點無聊。

ex.en: I had chicken pox when I was a kid.
ex.zh: 我小時候得過水痘。

ex.en: I brought up two kids all on my own.
ex.zh: 我一個人把兩個小孩養大。

ex.en: Because our kids got married, we are now in-laws.
ex.zh: 我們的孩子結婚了，所以我們現在是親家。

ex.en: Tom realized that Mary wasn't kidding.
ex.zh: 湯姆發現瑪莉不是在開玩笑。

ex.en: Are you kidding me?
ex.zh: 你在開玩笑吧？

ex.en: Don't worry, I'm just kidding!
ex.zh: 別擔心，我只是開玩笑的啦！

ex.en: The volcano erupted suddenly, killing many people.
ex.zh: 火山突然噴發，造成許多人死亡。

ex.en: Most people killed by smoking were not heavy smokers.
ex.zh: 大多數因吸菸而死的人並不是老菸槍。

ex.en: Don't kill too many birds and animals on earth.
ex.zh: 不要過度捕殺地球上的鳥類和動物。

ex.en: I read a magazine to kill time.
ex.zh: 我看雜誌打發時間。

ex.en: We killed time at a café before the movie.
ex.zh: 電影開演前我們在咖啡店打發時間。

kill.zh: kill two birds with one stone：一舉兩得

ex.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 這樣我就一舉兩得了。

ex.en: Let's kill two birds with one stone and visit the client on the way.
ex.zh: 我們順路拜訪客戶，一舉兩得。

ex.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll kiss you.
ex.zh: 如果你買冰淇淋給我，我就親你一下。

ex.en: At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.
ex.zh: 典禮結束時，新人互相親吻。

ex.en: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
ex.zh: 頭獎是公主的一個吻。

ex.en: She gave her son a goodnight kiss.
ex.zh: 她給兒子一個晚安吻。

ex.en: He is kicking me!
ex.zh: 他在踢我！

ex.en: He kicked the ball into the goal.
ex.zh: 他把球踢進球門。

ex.en: The coin toss decides who will kick off the match.
ex.zh: 擲硬幣決定由哪一隊開球。

ex.en: The conference kicks off on Monday.
ex.zh: 研討會星期一開幕。

ex.en: They kicked him out of the disco without any explanation.
ex.zh: 他們沒有任何解釋就把他趕出了舞廳。

ex.en: He was kicked out of the team.
ex.zh: 他被踢出了球隊。

ex.en: Once there lived a king whose name was Alfred.
ex.zh: 從前有一位名叫阿佛烈的國王。

ex.en: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
ex.zh: 國王明晚會親自現身。

ex.en: When I grow up, I want to be king.
ex.zh: 我長大後想當國王。

ex.en: He needs a kidney transplant.
ex.zh: 他需要腎臟移植。

ex.en: Drinking enough water is good for your kidneys.
ex.zh: 喝足夠的水對腎臟有益。

ex.en: I can hear Tom in the kitchen washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我聽到湯姆在廚房洗碗的聲音。

ex.en: Tell the children to stay out of the kitchen.
ex.zh: 告訴孩子別進廚房。

ex.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.
ex.zh: 美式廚房比日式廚房大得多。

ex.en: Kindly confirm the delivery address by noon.
ex.zh: 請於中午前確認送貨地址。

ex.en: The receptionist kindly helped our visitors.
ex.zh: 接待人員親切地協助訪客。

ex.en: Buy your transit pass at the kiosk beside the station entrance.
ex.zh: 請在車站入口旁的小亭購買交通月票。

ex.en: Passengers checked in at a self-service kiosk.
ex.zh: 乘客在自助服務機辦理報到。
